name: Onogami Shigehiko
source:
The protagonist of the first kaleidoscope story. 

Shigehiko comes from a wealthy household. He is well educated in both practical and artistic studies.

He is also quite popular as a teacher in an all-girls school. While he made a vow never to lay hands on his students, he finds himself inexplicably attracted to Kirie.
